clauses.statement: Evidence change-surface resolution classifies every changed path as product_code, docs, evidence_artifacts, or unknown, and reports docs_only only when at least one docs path changed and no product_code path changed. An unclassified path, a VibePro-record-only change, an empty observed change set, and an unavailable diff-stats status each resolve to unknown rather than docs_only, so a lost measurement never lightens evidence. Under docs/, the deployed manual surface (docs/.vitepress/, docs/public/) and machine-read responsibility contracts (docs/contracts/) classify as product_code, while the requirement trees (docs/management/, docs/specs/, docs/architecture/, docs/adr/) classify as docs whatever their file extension. A docs_only verdict names the VibePro-managed records it tolerated so the accepted exclusion is never silent. Machine-read registries inside the documentation trees (docs/architecture/target-model.json, docs/management/roi-ledger/, docs/management/responsibility-authority/) also classify as product_code because VibePro reads them at runtime to drive verdicts.

clauses.statement: A docs-only change defaults to the summary persistence depth, and an explicit requested evidence depth remains authoritative over that default so a documentation change can still be escalated. A change that touches product code keeps the pre-existing implementation depth resolution unchanged. The docs-only default does not override the pre-existing risk escalation: a docs-only change with a high-risk profile or an active trigger signal keeps the depth it resolved to before this change, and keeps its recorded risk_profile and trigger_signals.

clauses.statement: The canonical evidence cost budget defines a docs_only profile separate from the normal and high implementation profiles. The docs_only profile keeps the same absolute canonical artifact line threshold as the normal profile and does not apply the artifact-to-code ratio rule, because a docs-only change has no product-code denominator. Budget verdicts are reported on separated axes: budget_scope names which axis applies, implementation_budget_status is not_applicable for a docs-only change, and docs_only_budget_status is not_applicable for an implementation change. A caller-supplied budget that predates the docs_only profile falls back to the normal profile rather than becoming unbounded. The docs_only profile is never stricter than the risk-based profile the same change would otherwise use: it preserves the ratio-derived effective line floor through line_budget_ratio and takes the more permissive of both line budgets and both floors, recording the relaxed-over risk profile in budget.risk_profile_basis.

clauses.statement: scenario_clause_e2e: given a repository whose pull request has already been merged so that origin/<base> contains the branch head, when merge diff-line statistics are collected, then the base branch is rejected as a diff base and the pre-merge base is recovered from the merge commit first parent for both a merge commit and a squash merge; when no usable pre-merge base exists, then diff statistics are recorded as unavailable with the containment reason instead of an available zero-line change set, so canonical evidence cost keeps product_changed_lines null rather than zero. Before the merge lands, the base branch remains the diff base.

clauses.statement: Canonical evidence cost distinguishes a docs-only zero from an unmeasured zero: product_code_changed_lines is zero with reason docs_only for a docs-only change, and null with status unavailable and reason diff_stats_unavailable when the diff base could not be resolved. An unmeasured change surface is never classified as docs_only and stays on the implementation budget scope.

clauses.statement: The existing evidence depth planner contract is not re-implemented: docs-only detection enters as a planner input. The planner keeps its schema version, its summary-first default depth, its artifact policy vocabulary, and its risk escalation behaviour, and additionally records the docs-only verdict, its reason, and the resolved default_depth_reason. An externally resolved docs-only verdict supplied by the caller is used as the planner input.

A canonical bundle promoted before the docs-only profile carries no budget_scope and stays on the implementation axis, so historical counts are unchanged.
